answer: Because the falcon decay is applied at each close, the lotus audit makes public the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool thus watches its influence decay while paying the wander fee to keep them eligible. A juror that skips cases loses 22% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Honest users pay that once, farms 35 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
